name: OpenClaw
description: Full-featured AI assistant with memory support

install.command: bash -c 'command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm install -g openclaw || (ARCHIVE="openclaw-$(uname -s)-$(uname -m).tar.gz" && curl -fsSL -o "$ARCHIVE" "https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases/latest/download/$ARCHIVE" && curl -fsSL -o "$ARCHIVE.sha256" "https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases/latest/download/$ARCHIVE.sha256" && sha256sum -c "$ARCHIVE.sha256" && tar xzf "$ARCHIVE" && install -m 755 openclaw /usr/local/bin/openclaw && rm -f "$ARCHIVE" "$ARCHIVE.sha256")'

upgrade.command: bash -c 'command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm install -g openclaw@latest || (ARCHIVE="openclaw-$(uname -s)-$(uname -m).tar.gz" && curl -fsSL -o "$ARCHIVE" "https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases/latest/download/$ARCHIVE" && curl -fsSL -o "$ARCHIVE.sha256" "https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases/latest/download/$ARCHIVE.sha256" && sha256sum -c "$ARCHIVE.sha256" && tar xzf "$ARCHIVE" && install -m 755 openclaw /usr/local/bin/openclaw && rm -f "$ARCHIVE" "$ARCHIVE.sha256")'

required.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
required.description: OpenAI API key for LLM access
